Footprint data in terms of working time in hours, salaries and GHG emissions in the motor vehicles industry in Germany (1995-2020) based on MRIO consumption-based calculations using Exiobase 3.9.6. Resource requirements per vehicle produced in the German Motor Vehicles Industry and the vehicles purchased in Germany. Regional and sectoral distribution of the footprints for contribution analysis. This data also includes top10 according to contribution in working time, GHG emissions and salaries for detailed countries, sectors, and sector-countries. For methods, check paper.
